description: Fetch a finding by human identifier such as ODI-12 (preferred) or by internal findingId. Returns bounded remediation context, the suggested branch name, linked GitHub pull requests, workflow readiness, and retest state. Odin only provides context and can link an existing PR; it never creates commits, pushes branches, or creates pull requests.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.

name: get_finding
title: Get finding remediation context
